root_cause: Package 'fake_missing_package' PyPI par exist nahi karta, isliye pip install fail ho raha hai
explanation: Commit message me likha hai ki 'fake_missing_package' dependency ko auto-add kiya gaya hai requirements.txt file ki line 34 me. Lekin ye package PyPI (Python Package Index) par available nahi hai. Jab CI/CD pipeline ne dependencies install karne ki koshish ki, to pip is non-existent package ko download nahi kar paya aur exit code 1 ke saath fail ho gaya. Ye ek 'self-heal' attempt tha jo galat package name add kar diya.
suggested_fix: 1. requirements.txt se line 34 par 'fake_missing_package' entry ko remove karo. 2. Agar koi actual missing dependency hai to uska sahi naam identify karke add karo. 3. Self-heal automation script ko review karo jo galat package names add kar raha hai aur usko disable ya fix karo. 4. Changes commit karke pipeline dubara run karo.
